description: This file defines the XmlWidgetConditionVisitor class, which generates XML representation of widget model conditions within the OFBiz framework. It implements traversal and serialization logic for various condition types used in widget configurations, converting internal condition objects into corresponding XML fragments.

classes.name: XmlWidgetConditionVisitor
classes.description: This class extends XmlAbstractWidgetVisitor and implements ModelConditionVisitor to generate XML for widget conditions by traversing condition objects and writing corresponding XML snippets.

methods.name: visit(And and)
methods.description: Serializes an 'And' condition by wrapping sub-conditions in <and> tags.

methods.name: visit(IfCompare ifCompare)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfCompare' condition into an <if-compare> XML element with relevant attributes.

methods.name: visit(IfCompareField ifCompareField)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfCompareField' condition into an <if-compare-field> XML element.

methods.name: visit(IfEmpty ifEmpty)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfEmpty' condition into an <if-empty> XML element.

methods.name: visit(IfEmptySection ifEmptySection)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfEmptySection' condition into an <if-empty-section> element.

methods.name: visit(IfEntityPermission ifEntityPermission)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfEntityPermission' condition; currently a placeholder with no additional attributes.

methods.name: visit(IfHasPermission ifHasPermission)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfHasPermission' condition into an <if-has-permission> element.

methods.name: visit(IfRegexp ifRegexp)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfRegexp' condition into an <if-regexp> element.

methods.name: visit(IfServicePermission ifServicePermission)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfServicePermission' condition into an <if-service-permission> element.

methods.name: visit(IfValidateMethod ifValidateMethod)
methods.description: Serializes an 'IfValidateMethod' condition into an <if-validate-method> element.

methods.name: visit(ModelMenuCondition modelMenuCondition)
methods.description: Serializes a 'ModelMenuCondition' into a <condition> element and further processes its nested condition.

methods.name: visit(Not not)
methods.description: Serializes a 'Not' condition into a <not> element with its subordinate condition.

methods.name: visit(Or or)
methods.description: Serializes an 'Or' condition into <or> tags with nested conditions.

methods.name: visit(Xor xor)
methods.description: Serializes an 'Xor' condition into <xor> tags with nested conditions.
